name: Jennings (United States)
description: Dark blue field charged with a four-pointed star counterchanged red and white, between the words CITY OF JENNINGS and INCORPORATED 1946 in white.
history: Jennings is a city in St. Louis County, Missouri. The flag was adopted in 1964 (designed in 1964 by an eighth-grade girl, according to Flags of the World citing the Jennings Historical Society).

features.role: four-pointed star counterchanged red and white
words CITY OF JENNINGS and INCORPORATED 1946
